wikispeech-desc: Qalab qoraal u beddelid hadal ah oo mashaariicda Wikimedia ka dhigaya kuwo si fudud loogu heli karo dadka sababo kala duwan awgood ay ku adag tahay akhrisku.
wikispeech-notice-prefs-apply-on-next-pa: Isbeddellada lagu sameeyo dookyada waxay dhaqan geli doonaan marka bogga xiga la soo raro. Si aad bogga hadda jira ugu dhagaysato dookyada cusub, dib u soo rar bogga ka dib markaad kaydiso.
wikispeech-error-loading-audio-message: Tan waxaa sababi kara isku-xir internet oo liita ama khalad ka dhacay server-ka. Ma rabtaa inaad mar kale isku daydo ama joojiso ciyaarista?
wikispeech-lexicon-copyrightnote: Markaad kaydiso isbeddellada, waxaad oggolaanaysaa in wax ku biirintaada lagu sii daayo [https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ CC0].
